body:
lauren.p: NimbleAccel told us they're changing gateway headers + payload layout. Flip date 2026-05-15. They want marketplace + SDK paths to be forward-compatible. Thoughts?

mike.dev: Quick win: runtime translation shim in the marketplace image to map old->new. Fast rollback if issues.

sanjay: Agree. Also prepare an SDK fallback flag for customers who can't update immediately. Shim + opt-in SDK is safest.

anna.docs: I'll draft a short migration doc and test harness README. Need exact diffs from Nimble to fill examples.

taylor.pm: Proposed milestones:
- 2026-03-30: partner notice + internal heads-up
- 2026-04-08: shim canary deployed + QA
- 2026-04-18: migration guide + test harness published
- 2026-04-22: SDK patch (opt-in) release
- 2026-05-15: partner flips; shim remains for 90 days

helen.nimble: From NimbleAccel: X-Accel-Version -> X-NA-Version, and model_id moves under meta.model_ref. We'll keep old behavior for 90 days post-flip. Spec link incoming.

mike.dev: Draft shim pseudocode:
if headers["X-Accel-Version"] then headers["X-NA-Version"] = headers["X-Accel-Version"]
if body.model_id then body.meta = body.meta || {}; body.meta.model_ref = body.model_id; delete body.model_id
We'll add unit tests + contract test.

lauren.p: Action owners:
- lauren.p: send partner notice by 2026-03-30
- sanjay: rollout ticket + infra checklist by 2026-03-31
- mike.dev: implement shim + tests by 2026-04-08
- anna.docs: draft docs + examples by 2026-04-18
- taylor.pm: marketplace announcement coordination by 2026-04-25

anna.docs: Example snippet I'll include once spec is live.

deploy-bot: marketplace-image/na-compat-shim deployed to canary (sha: c0ffee9) at 2026-04-08T14:10:05Z :rocket:

mike.dev: PR ready for review. Requesting @sanjay and @anna.docs for test vectors.

sanjay: Reviewing now. Please include perf guard: shim should add <5ms p50.

lauren.p: Thanks all 9 once PR merges I'll send partner notice and the migration link. :thumbsup:
